whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.description: Our team noticed that each year the rate of illness is rising. For that reason, we decided to gather all information about health and healthy lifestyle in one place. We hope that our website will help people find valuable information that can totally reduce disease rates.

ourGoal.title: Our Goal
ourGoal.description: We want to share people's experiences and knowledge with all visitors. We hope our articles will serve as a life instructor and raise the quality of your life. Together, we can build a healthier Uzbekistan, one person at a time.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Vido FitLife and how we can help you live healthier

items.question: Is Vido FitLife free to use?
items.answer: Yes! Vido FitLife is completely free. We believe everyone deserves access to quality health information. All our articles, workout guides, and recipes are available at no cost.

items.question: Are the workouts suitable for beginners?
items.answer: Absolutely! We categorize workouts by difficulty level - beginner, intermediate, and advanced. Our beginner routines require no equipment and focus on proper form and building consistency.

items.question: Do you offer personalized diet plans?
items.answer: While we don't offer one-on-one personalized plans, our recipes and nutrition guides provide general principles that work for most people. Always consult with a healthcare professional for specific medical conditions.

items.question: How often do you publish new content?
items.answer: We publish new articles, workouts, and recipes weekly. Subscribe to our newsletter to get notified about fresh content delivered straight to your inbox.

items.question: Can I contribute my own experience to Vido FitLife?
items.answer: Yes! We welcome community contributions. If you have a healthy living experience, recipe, or workout routine to share, contact us through our submission form. Your story could inspire others!
